tasks.title: The Climate of Japan
paras: Japan’s yearly weather cycle has played a key role in shaping its civilization. (A)It has assured the islands ample precipitation, ranging irregularly from more than 200 centimeters annually in parts of the southwest to about 100 in the northeast and averaging 180 for the country as a whole. (B)The moisture enables the islands to support uncommonly lush forest cover, but the combination of precipitous slopes and heavy rainfall also gives the islands one of the world’s highest rates of natural erosion, intensified by both human activity and the natural shocks of earthquakes and volcanism. (C)These factors have given Japan its wealth of sedimentary basins, but they have also made mountainsides extremely susceptible to erosion and landslides and hence generally unsuitable for agricultural manipulation. (D)The island chain’s mountainous backbone and great length from north to south produce climatic diversity that has contributed to regional differences. Generally sunny winters along the Pacific seaboard have made habitation there relatively pleasant. Along the Sea of Japan, on the other hand, cold, snowy winters have discouraged settlement. Furthermore, although annual precipitation is high in that region, much of it comes as snow and rushes to the sea as spring runoff, leaving little moisture for farming.

questions.stem: What is the passage mainly about?

options.A: The geological formation of Japan's sedimentary basins.
options.B: The impact of Japan's weather cycle on its civilization and regional differences.
options.C: The agricultural challenges caused by Japan's high precipitation.
options.D: The differences in settlement patterns between Japan's Pacific seaboard and Sea of Japan regions.

questions.analysis: 题型：主旨题 原文分析：文章开篇指出日本的年天气周期在塑造其文明中发挥了关键作用（“Japan’s yearly weather cycle has played a key role in shaping its civilization”），随后讨论了降水、侵蚀、地形和气候多样性如何影响森林覆盖、农业、沉积盆地以及地区定居模式（如太平洋沿岸与日本海沿岸的差异）。B选项全面概括了文章的主题。 选项分析： A 虽然文章提到日本的沉积盆地（sedimentary basins）是由侵蚀等因素形成的，但这只是文章的一部分内容，不是主要讨论的主题。文章的重点是气候对日本文明和地区差异的整体影响。 C 虽然文章提到高降水量导致的侵蚀和山坡不适合农业操作，但农业挑战只是文章的一部分内容，不是主要讨论的主题。文章更广泛地探讨了气候对文明和地区差异的影响。 D 文章确实提到了太平洋沿岸和日本海沿岸的定居模式差异（例如太平洋沿岸的晴朗冬季适合居住，日本海沿岸的寒冷多雪冬季不利于定居），但这只是气候影响的一个方面，不是文章的主要主题。D选项过于狭隘。

questions.stem: According to the passage, all of the following contribute to the high rate of erosion in the Japanese EXCEPT

options.A: very steep slopes and heavy rainfall

questions.analysis: 题型：否定事实信息题 原文分析：B选项错误（不是侵蚀原因）。文章提到山坡因侵蚀和滑坡“generally unsuitable for agricultural manipulation”（通常不适合农业操作），说明农业操作受侵蚀限制，而不是侵蚀的原因。因此，B选项不是导致高侵蚀率的因素。 选项分析： A选项对应 “the combination of precipitous slopes and heavy rainfall also gives the islands one of the world’s highest rates of natural erosion”。 C、D选项 “intensified by both human activity and the natural shocks of earthquakes and volcanism”，明确指出地震和火山活动以及人类活动是侵蚀的加剧因素。

questions.stem: The phrase “susceptible to” is closest in meaning to
questions.analysis: 题型：词汇题 选项分析：susceptible to是“容易受到…影响的”的意思。对应B选项。 A选项意为“缓慢恢复损失”。C选项意为“无法从……中受益”。D选项意为“以……而闻名”。

questions.stem: According to the passage, which of the following is a major factor in the limited habitation in the area along the Sea of Japan?

options.B: It is vulnerable to floods during spring runoff
options.C: Its climate is highly irregular and unpredictable
options.D: It is cold and snowy during winter

questions.analysis: 题型：细节题 原文分析：文章明确指出，“Along the Sea of Japan, on the other hand, cold, snowy winters have discouraged settlement”，说明寒冷多雪的冬季是日本海沿岸定居受限的主要因素。对应D选项。 选项分析： A 文章提到日本的山地地形（mountainous backbone）影响气候多样性，但没有具体说日本海沿岸的定居受限是因为山地过多。定居受限的主要原因是气候，而不是地形。 B 文章提到日本海沿岸的降水多以雪的形式出现，并在春季融化后迅速流入海洋（“rushes to the sea as spring runoff”），但没有说春季径流导致洪水或洪水是定居受限的主要因素。 C 文章没有描述日本海沿岸的气候为“高度不规律和不可预测”。相反，文章提到该地区有寒冷多雪的冬季，这是一个明确的季节性特征，而不是不规律的气候。

questions.stem: There are four locations (A, B, C, and D) in the passage that indicate where the following sentence could be added. Such a large amount of rainfall has both positive and negative effects on the environment of Japanese islands.
questions.analysis: 题型：插入题 原文分析：Such a large amount of rainfall指代上文的ample precipitation。后文继续讲解positive and negative effects。
